profile.name: Rowan Liu
profile.headline: Frontend-leaning Full-stack Engineer
profile.tagline: I build heavy enterprise systems with a soft, minimal interface: Angular, Node.js BFF, production debugging, and AI-assisted delivery.
profile.summary: 10 years across Vue, React and Angular; currently focused on modern Angular, Node.js BFF, enterprise check-in flows, document scanning and production troubleshooting.

design.inspiration: Sean Halpin-style playful minimalism adapted for a hardcore full-stack resume
principles: Soft light background and rounded 2xl/3xl cards
Programmer-native 2D visuals: terminal, code blocks, Angular/Vue abstract marks
Progressive disclosure: one-line impact summaries first, deep technical details in expanded cards
Micro-interactions: floating cards, magnetic hover, smooth shared-layout modal transitions

experiences.summary: Building Cathay Pacific's customer-facing online check-in system with Angular + Node.js BFF under an English agile workflow.
details: Develop modern Angular frontend modules for passenger-facing online check-in flows.
Contribute to Node.js BFF API composition and data filtering between frontend flows and backend services.
Integrate Scandit-based document scanning for passports, Hong Kong/Macau permits, China residence permits and visas.
Troubleshoot production issues with analytics and Kibana signals, connecting user behavior to system-level root causes.
Collaborate in an English agile team, translating product requirements and Figma details into reliable production UI.
experiences.impact: A heavy enterprise travel workflow presented as clear, resilient customer-facing interactions.

experiences.summary: Using Copilot, Figma MCP and agent-based review to compress the design-to-code-to-review loop without losing engineering judgment.
details: Use GitHub Copilot for implementation acceleration while keeping code ownership and review discipline.
Use Figma MCP to bridge design context and frontend implementation details.
Apply AI-agent review patterns for pre-commit checks, risk spotting and refactoring feedback.
Prefer AI as an engineering amplifier, not a replacement for architecture, debugging or product judgment.
experiences.impact: A modern delivery loop that keeps craft high while moving faster.

experiences.summary: A child literacy and character-recognition product idea designed around a real first user: Julianna.
details: Explore product loops for children learning characters through friendly, repeatable interactions.
Use Julianna as the initial user group to keep the product grounded in real behavior instead of abstract features.
Potentially combine frontend play patterns, progress tracking, speech/recognition and AI-assisted content generation.
Positioned as a warm personal product that also demonstrates full-stack product ownership.
experiences.impact: A personal project with product taste, empathy and practical user feedback built in.

projects.name: 10-year Frontend Knowledge Base
projects.summary: A long-running technical blog covering Vue internals, Angular evolution, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js and frontend architecture.
details: Uses the personal blog as a durable engineering memory across frameworks and years.
Shows breadth from foundational JavaScript/CSS to Angular SSR, hydration and BFF topics.
